components.text: Independent connector for Azure DevOps. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Azure DevOps.
Sign in to Azure DevOps and note the organization name from https://dev.azure.com/{organization}. Enter it below; the connection test runs against that organization.

Open User settings → Personal access tokens and create a token for that organization with an expiry and the Code (Read) scope, which covers listing repositories and reading files and archives. Azure DevOps accepts a PAT as HTTP Basic credentials with any username: enter any non-empty username (for example your email) and the token in the protected field.

Test makes read-only GET https://dev.azure.com/{organization}/_apis/connectionData and checks the authenticated user ID; an invalid token is refused with 401. A successful test does not prove access to every project. Save encrypts the username and token together. After rotating the token, replace the saved Ragentic credential on the Credentials page and test again.
